currentContext.expansion: The Company's disclosed expansion in FY26 was R&D and capability build-out rather than manufacturing capacity addition. In FY26 a new product development centre for sealants, adhesives and coatings was established at Alandi at a cost of over Rs 5 crore, covering infrastructure and state-of-the-art instrumentation, and now employs 14 scientists, engineers and chemists, up from 8 last year. The laboratories for metal treatment chemicals at the head office in Mahape are also being upgraded, and management says such higher-than-proportionate R&D investment will continue in the medium term. On the commercial side, the Metal Treatment Chemicals business expanded its footprint across all sub-segments and across the country; Engineering Adhesives is expanding its product range into electronic adhesives and battery pack adhesives for a strategic entry into electronic components and battery packs for EVs and electricity storage; and the Company developed products to replace imports from its erstwhile US-based technical partner, ND Industries, Inc. Management also notes that after the demerger the consolidated operating profit margins show it is now able to better absorb existing resources, and that consolidated EBITDA growth came partly from better utilisation of existing resources. No plant-level capacity addition, commissioning timeline or rupee capex quantum is disclosed in the routed text.

risks.risk: Raw material price volatility and input-cost pass-through lag
risks.note: The MD&A records a sharp increase in raw material prices from late Q3 onwards which cut over 2 percentage points from product and gross margins, with management stating the bottom line is under stress from elevated input costs because customers accept the necessary price increases only with a lag. Elevated crude oil prices cascade into raw material prices.

risks.risk: Competition from global MNCs with larger R&D budgets and established OEM relationships
risks.note: Listed as a Threat in the MD&A. Chembond's growth depends on winning and holding automotive OEM qualifications, where incumbents have deeper R&D capability and existing relationships; the Company's own answer is a higher-than-proportionate R&D spend which it calls possibly the only way to outgrow the competition.

risks.risk: Price-led competition from global MNCs and local companies
risks.note: Listed as a Threat in the MD&A - price-based competition in the Company's market segments comes from both multinational and domestic players, pressuring realisations in a business whose gross margin is already compressing.

risks.risk: Dependence on continuous innovation and new-product introduction
risks.note: The MD&A Risks & Concerns section states that growth of the performance materials and biosciences industry is driven by a need for constant innovation, which a strong R&D focus must sustain. Almost all of the sealants segment's three-year 30% sales CAGR came from newly introduced products, so a stalled pipeline directly stalls growth.

risks.risk: Safety, health and environmental exposure of chemical manufacturing
risks.note: The MD&A states the Company is exposed to safety, health and environmental risks given the diversity and complexity of its industry, and separately lists as a Threat that chemical manufacturing processes are subject to environmental hazards including pollution and waste management issues. Mitigation cited: frequent SHE audits, safety training across all locations and a Safety, Health and Environment Policy.

Listed as a Threat: economic or geopolitical events such as wars can raise raw material costs or cause delivery delays that create supply chain instability, hitting margins and sales. Management explicitly cites the ongoing Middle East crisis with no clarity on how long it will last, alongside the Russia-Ukraine war.

Listed as a Threat: digitization of the industry increases the risk of cyberattacks which may lead to data loss, operational disruption and financial loss - relevant given the Company runs SAP S/4HANA as its platform for data capture, accounting, consolidation and management reporting.

risks.risk: Macro-economic sensitivity - government policy, currency and commodity volatility
risks.note: The MD&A states that macro-economic conditions such as government policy decisions, currency fluctuations and commodity price volatility can affect the business, partly mitigated because the Company's revenue-generating sources are diversified into various sectors with strong domestic demand.

risks.risk: Pending litigation against the Company and its Directors
risks.note: The Board's Report discloses one pending litigation against the Company and its Directors whose order is yet to be received, explained in the Corporate Governance section; apart from this no significant or material order impacting going-concern status was passed by regulators, courts or tribunals.
